moves.name: Follow Me
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 2
Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 95
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.description:
Water (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.description:
Fairy (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)

Accuracy: N/A

Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description:
Ice (Special)

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Babiri Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Steel-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Kebia Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Poison-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Focus Sash

items.name: Bright Powder

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.description: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.description: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.description: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.
